label: August 10–16, 2026
intro: One week until BICT Fest — grab your tickets now if you haven't. Meanwhile, Toob North runs through Aug 30 and the rinks are wide open for some pre-festival adventure.
weekday_note: Weekday mornings at Cloud 11 are your best bet for hands-on maker time before the August 21 BICT surge fills your calendar.

activities.title: ClassBento Kids Ceramic Workshop
activities.date: Book a weekend slot at classbento.co.th
activities.location: Multiple Bangkok studios (central BKK / Thonglor area)
activities.price: Check classbento.co.th for current session price
activities.why: Hands-on pinch pots, slabs, and coils for kids age 5+. Thor builds and decorates something from scratch and takes it home — same clay energy as the pottery classes he already loves, available most weekends.
activities.tip: Book at classbento.co.th/ceramic-workshop-for-kids a few days ahead — weekend slots fill up.

activities.title: Toob North at theCOMMONS Cloud 11 — Final Stretch
activities.price: Free to browse; workshop sessions priced individually
activities.why: With only 3 weeks left of Toob North, mid-August is a great moment to go if you haven't yet — or go again. Northern Thai potters and makers at their most relaxed. Great for hands-on clay and craft time with Thor.
activities.tip: Saturday or Sunday morning sessions have the most interactive maker access. This residency ends Aug 30 — don't leave it too late.

activities.title: Roller Dome Emporium — Weekend Session
activities.location: Roller Dome, Emporium Mall, Sukhumvit Soi 24 (Phrom Phong BTS)
activities.price: 150 THB/hr weekends; skate + protective gear included
activities.why: Consistent weekly rollerblading is how Thor's technique improves. Dedicated beginners grass area and coaches available. Mid-August weekends are quieter than the holiday peak.
activities.tip: Sunday morning 10–11am is consistently the quietest slot of the week.

activities.title: Sub-Zero Ice Skating — Weekday or Weekend
activities.time: Weekdays: 11:00 AM – 5:00 PM; weekends: check website
activities.location: Sub-Zero Ice Skate Club, Major Cineplex Sukhumvit (Ekkamai BTS, skywalk access)
activities.price: 100 THB kids / 200 THB adults (weekday); Wednesday discount 90 THB/hr; skate rental included
activities.why: Both Arena Rink (fun skating) and Academy Rink (coached sessions) available. Mid-August weekdays are quiet — great window before BICT Fest fills your schedule later in the month.
activities.tip: A 60-min coached lesson (~900 THB) will show visible progress in one visit — patient coaches who work well with young kids.

activities.title: Children's Discovery Museum
activities.location: Queen Sirikit Park, Chatuchak (Mo Chit BTS or Chatuchak Park MRT)
activities.why: Giant bubble stations, dinosaur fossil digs, tunnel of mirrors, Lego building zones, and outdoor water park. Free, hands-on, and built for discovery — exactly Thor's wavelength. Perfect rainy-season weekday outing.
activities.tip: Weekday visits avoid weekend crush. Bring a change of clothes for the water area on hot afternoons.

activities.title: The Marvel Experience Thailand
activities.date: Ongoing — book any day via Klook
activities.time: Check Klook for current show times
activities.location: Mega Bangna, Bang Phli (BTS On Nut + Grab ~30 min)
activities.price: Discounted tickets on Klook (up to 45% off)
activities.why: Iron Man's Stark Mobile Lab, 4D dome, VR flight training, and character meet-and-greets with Iron Man, Thor the Avenger, Spider-Man, and Hulk. Still the best guaranteed Iron Man fix in Bangkok.
activities.tip: Book on Klook. Weekday mornings have the shortest queues. Allow 2 hours.

activities.title: 🎭 BICT Fest Starts August 21 — Book Tickets This Week
activities.date: Festival runs August 21–30; book at bictfest.com NOW
activities.location: One Bangkok Park + Goethe-Institut Thailand + Sodsai Centre, Chulalongkorn Univ.
activities.price: Free programmes + ticketed shows on Eventpop
activities.why: 10th anniversary Bangkok International Children's Theatre Festival: 11 participatory shows from 9 countries where kids are part of the action. Designed for babies through teens. Rare, world-class kids programme — don't miss it.
activities.tip: Free programme slots go first and go fast. Head to bictfest.com right now — this week is your last safe window before it sells out.
